name: context_compressor_is_summary_access_or_quota_error
notes: Non-retryable summary auth/quota ladder (src/agent/context_compressor_pure.c::cc_is_summary_access_or_quota_error vs LIVE agent/context_compressor.py::_is_summary_access_or_quota_error). Input encoding 'reason|status|text' where reason is the port's failover code (35 auth / 36 auth_permanent / 40 rate_limit / 2 billing / else unknown) and the twin derives the SAME reason from the LIVE classify_api_error on a synthetic exception (asserted).
